[03] Residential

Homeowners and busy families.

Trust first: who comes into my home? Reviews, background checks, the same crew every time.

HOW WE GROW IT

  1. 1Reviews and trust signals where homeowners decide (Google, the website, the first call)
  2. 2An easy first clean with a clear path to weekly or biweekly
  3. 3Follow-up after the first clean, before the client books someone else

THE GROWTH PATH

First clean → recurring plan

WHAT THEY TYPE (OR ASK AI)

“Insured, background-checked house cleaning in {city}”

03/ 11CLEANING

[04] Short-term rental (within residential)

Airbnb hosts and property managers.

Reliability between guests: same-day turnovers, photos after each clean, laundry and restocking.

HOW WE GROW IT

  1. 1Be the cleaner hosts find when they search for turnover help
  2. 2Show reliability: checklists, photos, response time
  3. 3Grow inside each account: one host, more listings

THE GROWTH PATH

One property → every property they manage

WHAT THEY TYPE (OR ASK AI)

“Who does same-day turnover cleaning in {city}?”

04/ 11CLEANING

[05] Commercial

Facility, office and property managers.

Switching risk: they already have a vendor. They need proof you won't miss things, and a contract that renews.

HOW WE GROW IT

  1. 1Reach managers when the current vendor is failing (missed cleans, complaints)
  2. 2Make the walkthrough and quote fast and professional
  3. 3Plan renewals and upsells (floor care, day porter) before the contract ends

THE GROWTH PATH

Walkthrough → contract → renewal

WHAT THEY TYPE (OR ASK AI)

“Our current cleaning company keeps missing things…”

05/ 11CLEANING

[06] Only in cleaning

Recurring revenue is built on trust, and on crews you actually have.

Clients let your team into their homes and offices every week. And every new recurring client needs a crew slot. So we market trust, and we plan demand around capacity.

EXAMPLE · CREW CAPACITY THIS WEEK

  • Background-checked

    Say it, show it, and make it findable where people decide.

  • Insured & bonded

    Proof on the website, the quote and the walkthrough.

  • Same crew, every time

    The #1 reason homeowners stay. We build it into the offer.

  • Crew capacity

    Campaigns pause or slow down when crews are full, and push when slots open.

08/ 11CLEANING

[09] The numbers we watch

Four numbers that tell you if cleaning growth is real.

  • [ ]%

    Recurring conversion

    Share of first cleans that become a weekly or biweekly plan.

    Why: The best early sign that marketing brings the right clients.

  • $[ ]

    Client lifetime value

    What a recurring client is worth before they leave.

    Why: Tells you how much you can spend to win one.

  • $[ ]

    Cost per recurring client

    Marketing spend ÷ new recurring clients (not leads).

    Why: Replaces “cost per lead”, which hides bad leads.

  • [ ]%

    Contract renewals

    Commercial contracts renewed on time, and at what value.

    Why: Commercial growth lives or dies at renewal.
